what: The text line is split into word chunks and characters, and when the panel is 30% visible (only when scrolling down) each character in turn at 28ms (+.125s) flashes the accent color four or five times over .32s while opacity bounces between .2 and 1 before settling to its own color, and words blink at 39ms intervals (+.175s) over .26s — like gauge letters lighting up on a signal. When the panel leaves the screen while scrolling up it is switched off, so it lights again on the next scroll down.

options.on: now turns on as soon as it attaches, manual means the caller adds and removes the is-inview class (when tying it to another motion, like gauge steps)
options.look: quick: Small heading type — letters .22s · words .2s (each: 20; used together with word: 30)

note: No shadow. One color, --kf-accent — the original orange (#fc4f00) is mixed in semi-transparent
